description: This file defines the PHP class I18NGroup within the OrangeHRM entity namespace. It is an ORM-mapped class that corresponds to a database table 'ohrm_i18n_group', representing internationalization group data with properties for id, name, and title, including getter and setter methods.

classes.name: I18NGroup
classes.description: Entity class representing a group of internationalization entries, mapped to 'ohrm_i18n_group' table, with properties 'id', 'name', and 'title'.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the group.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the group.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the group.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the group.

methods.name: getTitle
methods.description: Returns the title of the group.

methods.name: setTitle
methods.description: Sets the title of the group.
